summary: Saint Stephen was the first Christian martyr and a witness to Christ’s forgiveness even in death. His courage inspires the Church to bear witness with peace.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Stephen as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Stephen, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
